statement.text: Conjecture For every prime $p$, there is a constant $c(p)$ (possibly $c(p)=p$ ) so that the union (as multisets) of any $c(p)$ bases of the vector space $({\mathbb Z}_p)^n$ contains an additive basis.

title: The additive basis conjecture
